job.title: Growth Marketing Manager: Paid Search
job.location: New York City, New York, United States

match.reason: Complete duties and qualifications support review. Strong SEM evidence; thought leadership, SaaS experience and hybrid NYC availability remain unverified.

responsibilities.requirement: Craft strategy and run SEM accounts for several clients across verticals.
evidence: Set up and managed more than 75 Google Ads/AdWords accounts with combined monthly spend of more than $476,000, supporting lead generation and multichannel client programs
responsibilities.reason: Direct agency multi-client SEM strategy and execution.

responsibilities.requirement: Expertise in technical levers of the Social platforms such as campaign structure/consolidation, creative testing methodology, audience strategy
evidence: Managed all marketing platforms: Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok with a 400k/month budget
responsibilities.reason: Social campaign management supports routine edits; detailed social test methodology is less explicit.

responsibilities.requirement: Have a deep understanding of our client’s products and competitors so you can launch the most effective paid search campaigns
evidence: Conducted keyword, audience, and competitive research to develop targeting, messaging, campaign, and growth recommendations
responsibilities.reason: Research directly informs targeting, messaging and campaign improvements.

responsibilities.requirement: Present weekly reporting on campaign performance, highlight what’s worked, new experiments to run, etc.
evidence: Generates daily analyses and weekly marketing reports with source-labeled metrics, findings, recommendations, and watch lists.
responsibilities.reason: Weekly reporting combines performance interpretation with recommended next actions.

responsibilities.requirement: Act as an advisor to guide a client on improving their bottom of funnel performance to improve various KPIs such as CPL, CPSQL, ROAS, CPA etc.
evidence: Designed and interpreted funnel testing across reach, comparison, conversion, micro-conversion, purchase, and internal customer lifetime value
responsibilities.reason: Funnel and acquisition optimization proven; sales-qualified lead measurement is unverified.

responsibilities.requirement: Staying on top of client communication + demonstrate strong project management skills.
evidence: Consulted directly with clients on business goals, pain points, campaign structure, and budget allocation
responsibilities.reason: Direct client consultation and documented SEM/project-management role.

responsibilities.requirement: Provide strategic insight on emerging trends and industry developments as they impact the paid search landscape.
evidence: Assessed inefficient legacy rule-based systems built using the Google Ads API and how newer Google machine-learning capabilities had made those systems outdated
responsibilities.reason: Direct evaluation of emerging platform capabilities and strategic implications.

required.requirement: demonstrated experience working with client stakeholders
evidence: Built conversion and attribution models and designed A/B and multivariate tests across multiple levels of the marketing funnel
required.reason: Agency client consulting and full-funnel campaign testing establish the combined capability.

required.requirement: You must have experience with walking through a reporting structure to communicate/display ad performance across different platforms
evidence: Built reporting pipelines using Funnel.io to consolidate data sources and presented performance data through Google Data Studio/Looker Studio
required.reason: Direct consolidated reporting and performance presentation.

required.requirement: You must be highly analytical and obsessed with achieving client KPIs.
evidence: Used industry-leading analytical tools to evaluate account performance and make data-driven recommendations
required.reason: Client-account analysis and demonstrated ROAS improvement support KPI focus.

required.requirement: Expertise with the intersection of paid, owned and earned media in search campaign orchestration (including alignment with SEO).
evidence: Consulted on SEO best practices and on-page optimization and coordinated marketing priorities with web, operations, creative, and other stakeholders
required.reason: Paid/owned and SEO coordination proven; earned-media orchestration is unverified.

required.requirement: Passionate about the search landscape, and can demonstrate thought leadership in the space.
evidence: Developed a repeatable Google Ads account-management system that maintained consistent service quality across clients regardless of spend; the system was adopted across the agency
required.reason: Original agency-wide practices demonstrate expertise; public thought leadership is unverified.

required.requirement: Deep knowledge liaising with Analytics to set up conversion tracking and events across search ad platforms
evidence: Configured GA4 and custom Google Tag Manager measurement/reporting
required.reason: Direct measurement setup and conversion-model experience support implementation and QA.
NYC hybrid attendance or relocation willingness is not established.

seniority.requirement: Minimum 3+ years of experience managing ad spend across Google and Bing.
evidence: Managed large AdWords, Bing Ads, Gemini, and Amazon Marketing Services accounts consisting of more than 150 campaigns with a $400,000 budget
seniority.reason: LifeSpan's June 2013–August 2016 role alone documents more than three years.

seniority.requirement: Spend at least 7 figures in ad spend ($1 million – $10 million minimum) across your career.
evidence: Managed 12 accounts, 32 campaigns, approximately 110,000 ad groups, and 1.6 million keywords with approximately $3.6 million in monthly spend for a single brand
seniority.reason: A documented $3.6 million monthly budget directly exceeds the career-spend minimum.

preferred.requirement: experience managing spend for a B2B SaaS product or a D2C brand
evidence: Managed all marketing platforms: Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok with a 400k/month budget
preferred.reason: GRIP6 consumer-brand advertising directly supports the D2C alternative.

preferred.requirement: having experience with Google Tag Manager and Hubspot is a plus
evidence: Configured GA4 and custom Google Tag Manager measurement/reporting
preferred.reason: GTM implementation proven; HubSpot appears in inventories without demonstrated implementation.

preferred.requirement: Experience working with the branding/creative team to produce high quality ad copy and creative assets
evidence: Worked closely with the Web Dev team and the content team to create custom landing pages and custom content for PMAX campaigns
preferred.reason: PMax creative collaboration proven; explicit Display assets and brand-guideline compliance are unverified.
